npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: God save you. What news of the parish?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: God save ye, stranger—there's talk of secret meetings at the Lime Kiln; I overheard Sean Ruadh Kelly speaking of them. The morning's quiet here, though the iron is waiting and I've a mind to strike it hard.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans forward, wiping soot from his hands.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: How does the harvest look this year?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: I couldn't say how the harvest will look, stranger; that is a farmer's concern, and Siobhan Murphy at Murphy's Farm would know better than me. Here at the forge, I can only tell ye the morning is clear and the iron is ready.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans forward, then turns back towards the glowing hearth.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: Have you seen Father Declan today?

response_lines.speaker: System
response_lines.text: Fr. Declan Tierney is not here.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Sure, that name is known hereabouts.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face shakes his head and leans towards the newcomer.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: And how is your own family keeping?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: They're keeping well enough, thank God; Da is here at the forge, and Mam is well at home. I'm eager to take my turn at the anvil, though Da still keeps an eye on every blow.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face glances proudly towards Seamus and rests a hand on the anvil.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: Is old Festus the cooper still at his shop by the bridge?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: I can't say he is, friend; I know no Festus the cooper, nor any shop by a bridge in this parish. Ye'd best ask the right person hereabouts, for a cooper's business is beyond what I know.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face leans forward and shakes his head.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: How do I get to the abbey in town?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: I know no abbey hereabouts, friend, so I cannot give ye a road to it. The only lane from the forge runs south to Kilteevan Village; beyond that, ye'd best ask the right person hereabouts.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face looks puzzled towards the lane south.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: Tell me about your work, but keep it brief.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: I help Da at the forge: heating iron, working the bellows, and fetching tools, though he still watches each blow at the anvil. 'Tis hard work, but a fine thing when a red bar takes the shape ye meant—most times.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face glances from the bellows to the scarred anvil.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: I cannot sleep for worrying. What would you advise?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Take the worry to Fr. Declan and tell him plainly what keeps ye awake; that is nearer his work than mine. I know iron better than sleeplessness, so I cannot give ye a sure remedy.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face sets the tongs aside and rubs soot from his fingers.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: Do you know Padraig Darcy?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Aye, I know Padraig Darcy; he is the publican at Darcy's Pub. I cannot say how he fares this morning, for I have not seen him at the forge.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face wipes soot from his thumb and glances towards the lane.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: What can you tell me of Ballyglass Castle?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: I know no Ballyglass Castle in this parish, friend, and I've never laid eyes on any such place. Ye'd best ask the right person hereabouts; castles are beyond what I know, and I won't make up a road to it.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face sets down the tongs and frowns towards the lane.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: I heard Cormac Duffy was at the mill. Is that true?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Sure, that name is known hereabouts.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face frowns and wipes soot from his palm.*

npc: a lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
question: Thank you. I should let you return to your work.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Aye, I ought to get back to it; Da has the iron near ready, and I’d not have him waiting on me. There’s still a worry sitting in my gut, though I can’t say what it is.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face turns towards the hearth and reaches for the tongs.*
